bifrost: bifrost_app::peek (springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs), bifrost_app::cache (springboard/render/src/purgeable.rs), bifrost_render::imgdec, springboard/src/shell/photos/thumbs.rs, springboard/sdk/src/thumbnail_error.rs (ThumbnailError, ThumbnailErrorCode)
summary: BifrOSt has a cached-thumbnail path and cache for apps (thumbnail_path, ThumbnailCache) and the image decoder and scaler a generator would need, but no generator for file types (images, text, PDF, audio, video) and no thumbnail-provider extension point for custom file types. The Quick Look panel that would show thumbnails is decoded by the shell and not drawn.

features.feature: Thumbnail generation for common file types
features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: images, Live Photos, text files, PDFs, audio and video files, USDZ (iOS and iPadOS only)
features.note: The thumbnails service draws text, image, audio/video (cover or waveform card), font, contact, calendar, web, archive (entry count) and clipping files; unknown types get the icon. No PDF, video poster frame or duration badge, no extension point for third-party providers. Needs a Midget check.

features.feature: Thumbnail request by size and scale (generateBestRepresentation)
features.note: Cache key is url, size and scale, and the caller renders into the returned path. No request object, no representation types, and no completion or error callback.

features.feature: Thumbnail representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail)
features.note: RepresentationType (icon, lowQualityThumbnail, thumbnail) and tiers() limit what a request produces; not yet read from the service request or drawn per tier. Needs a Midget check.

features.apple: Finder and Spotlight display thumbnails from QLThumbnailGenerator and extensions
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (thumb_service.rs, thumbnails.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. Searchable items store a thumbnail path, but the search panel does not draw it. Files shows only the picker preview from springboard/src/files/preview.rs:28 (preview_for), which picks an in-app preview kind, not a thumbnail.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/thumbnail_error.rs (ThumbnailError, ThumbnailErrorCode, classify); springboard/sdk/src/thumbnails.rs (ThumbnailError from State::Failed and RequestError)
features.note: Domain 'bifrost.thumbnails' and five codes (bad request, no such file, unsupported, cancelled, failed). The code is read from the shell's failure message, and a refused request maps to bad request. Host unit tests only. The codes are BifrOSt's own: the reference codes could not be read from the official page here, so they are not matched. The shell still answers with a message only. built on parity/team-j-quick-look; not yet verified on Midget.

gaps: No QLThumbnailProvider extension point for custom file types
No system-wide thumbnail display in Files, Spotlight or the search panel
No thumbnail generator for PDF, text, audio, video or Live Photo files; only the Photos app decodes images
No representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail) and no update or completion handlers
The shell answers a failed thumbnail with a message only; the error codes in springboard/sdk/src/thumbnail_error.rs are derived from it, and they are not the reference error codes.
